headline: Adjusted profit rises as guidance narrows and lifts
summary_short: Altria's Q2 net revenues were essentially flat at $6.11B (+0.1% y/y) as reported diluted EPS fell 2.8% to $1.37 on litigation and facility-consolidation charges, while adjusted diluted EPS rose 2.8% to $1.48.
summary_long: Q2 net revenues were essentially flat at $6.11B (+0.1% y/y) as higher smokeable-products and other-category revenue offset a 5.3% decline in oral tobacco. Reported diluted EPS fell 2.8% y/y to $1.37, driven by higher litigation charges, USSTC facility-consolidation costs, and unfavorable ABI-related items, partly offset by favorable tax items and fewer shares outstanding. Adjusted diluted EPS rose 2.8% to $1.48 on higher adjusted operating-companies income and buybacks. Cash fell to $2.37B from $3.53B q/q while long-term debt held roughly flat at $24.6B. Altria narrowed full-year adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $5.61-$5.72, raising the low end, and raised 2026 capex guidance to $375-450M from $300-375M.

drivers.explanation: CEO Sal Mancuso cited continued execution against the smoke-free portfolio, traditional-tobacco profitability initiatives, and significant shareholder returns; the release frames the quarter as 'steady, disciplined execution' supporting the narrowed full-year guide.

Higher smokeable-products net revenue (+0.7%, on pricing) and an all-other swing to positive were offset by a 5.3% decline in oral tobacco net revenue on lower shipment volume and higher promotional investment.

Reported EPS fell on higher tobacco-and-health litigation items, 2026 USSTC Facilities Consolidation costs, and unfavorable ABI-related special items, partly offset by favorable income tax items, fewer shares outstanding and lower amortization of intangibles.
